statement: For the actual full boundary-quotient family having exactly one lifted fiber partition, the restricted ambient-null loop on the open orbit has a based compact-open contraction commuting with every original operator stabilizer and inducing the prescribed natural median contraction on every boundary quotient. The source and target covering equations and restriction kernel are retained. The assertion is intrinsic to the open orbit, with ambient frontier continuity still required.
depends_on: C27 median naturality; C29 zero-winding target lift; C30 free proper operator closure; C31 inverse continuity; C32 null evaluation loop; C33 free proper Lie group coordinates and slices; C43 real quotient global product; C44 exact cyclic fiber gauges; C45 dependent quotient reparametrizations; C46 exact operator permutation of the full boundary family
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), infinite-operator zero-level comparison and actual boundary quotient compatibility
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The original loop is ambient-null, the family consists of all actual quotients from the specified stabilizer-fixed boundary points, and every covering and operator restriction is retained.
notes: The proof constructs the actual group of all lifts of the closed proper operator image and proves its topology and free proper action. The base centralizer of the transitive lifted boundary group is proved to be a translation group. Its kernel on a fiber is exactly 1,Z,orR. For kernels Z and R, properness and the compact circle quotient in the Z case force a closed base image. Explicit gauges give all component actions, retaining negative fiber signs and scalars. With trivial kernel the discrete quotient-surface group is 1,Z,orZ squared; the dense Z-squared case yields a minimal torus foliation and an explicit suspension-to-linear-foliation conjugacy. Convex fiber interpolation and the exact median base contraction preserve every displayed operator equation. The transitive two-dimensional case uses explicit right multiplications. No ambient frontier extension is asserted. The source-search record includes Mion-Mouton Proposition2.5, but the needed single-foliation conjugacy is proved here with its maps.
